g.text: Goal: Add CSV export and full-text search to the notes CLI: `notes export --csv FILE` writes every note (title,
tags, created) and `notes search QUERY` lists matches, title hits first.
T1 Add the export subcommand · 1 check
T2 Quote commas and newlines · 1 check
T3 Add the search subcommand · 1 check
T4 Rank title matches first · 1 check
T5 Bump the version and the changelog · 1 check
